metadata.llm_reason: Candidate skill 41105c9d-6a2c-58d0-a4bc-26e978ee1553 is semantically identical to existing skill 07979eac-f1a1-5bda-8fb4-e448888f946c: both address catching BrokenProcessPool exceptions from ProcessPoolExecutor worker termination, logging failures, discarding the executor, and implementing recovery or escalation. The candidate adds minor workflow detail (explicit try-except wrapping, backoff strategy mention) but does not materially change the core capability. The existing skill already covers the full scope. Peer candidate 97b85b8a-5007-5e99-830e-58b6d29dd6e3 addresses initializer-time failures (different stage: initialization vs. execution), and 14f81fa3-e5cd-5b13-88aa-32621a04cbe3 addresses ThreadPoolExecutor (different executor type), so they are distinct and should not be merged.
